nodes.title: BLE GATT service enumeration
nodes.summary: Observed full GATT tree via nRF Connect CLIENT view 2026-10-25 (T60 60:1A:B7:00:AE:67, connected/bonded): 0x1801 and 0x1800 (no characteristics); 0x55FF (0x33F1 READ+WRITE; 0x33F2 NOTIFY+CCCD); 0x56FF (0x34F1 READ+WRITE NO RESPONSE; 0x34F2 NOTIFY+CCCD); 0x60FF (0x6001 READ+WRITE; 0x6002 NOTIFY+CCCD); 0x61FF (no characteristics); 0x180F Battery Service (0x2A19 READ+NOTIFY = 100%, CCCD); D0FF with 0xFFD1 WRITE NO RESPONSE and 0xFFD2/FFD3/FFD4/FFF1/FFE0/FFE1/FFF3/FFF4/FFF5 READ; 00006287-3c17-d293-8e48-14fe2e4da212 (0x6387 WRITE NO RESPONSE; 0x6487 NOTIFY+WRITE + CCCD); 000002fd-3c17-d293-8e48-14fe2e4da212 (0xFD03 WRITE+WRITE NO RESPONSE; 0xFD04 NOTIFY + CCCD; no READ). The SPP UUID 6a24eeab-4b65-4693-986b-3c26c352264f is not a GATT service. No writes or subscriptions.

nodes.title: FFF1 device information response
nodes.summary: Observed 13-byte payload: 0B 01 1D 00 51 01 00 F7 00 00 00 00 00, first via the Work session and independently re-confirmed 2026-10-25 by a live READ of characteristic 0xFFF1 in service 0000d0ff-3c17-d293-8e48-14fe2e4da212 using the explicit Read control of nRF Connect (screenshots + uiautomator dumps, stored outside Git). Corrected 2026-10-25: the SDK contains an explicit parser (DeviceInfo.parseX0000, see fact-fff1-parser) whose byte 0 is the IC type; byte 0 = 0x0B = IC_BB2 is documented by that parser, and the full payload decodes under its specVersion=1 layout (secureVersion 0x1D, mode 0, maxBufferCheckSize 0x0151, otaTempBufferSize 0, imageVersionIndicator 0; byte 7 unused) as inferred-strong given the exact GATT layout match.

nodes.title: FFF1 byte 0 may be the Realtek IC ID
nodes.summary: FFF1 byte 0 is observed as 0x0B and the GloryFit SDK maps IC_BB2 to 0x0B. Corrected 2026-10-25: the earlier 'no parser' gap is closed — DeviceInfo.parseX0000 (see fact-fff1-parser) explicitly reads byte 0 as the IC type, and the T60's live GATT layout exactly matches the SDK default profile, so this interpretation is now strong; the exact end-to-end invocation path for this characteristic (GATT FFF1 read vs X0000 command response) is not yet traced, so the label stays inferred.

nodes.title: Realtek SDK 0B -> BB2 mapping
nodes.summary: Verified from primary source in GloryFit v4.0.12 (APK pulled from the dedicated phone 2026-10-24 under owner authorization): classes5.dex embeds the RealSil SDK (com.realsil.sdk, Realtek's MCU brand) whose com.realsil.sdk.dfu.DfuConstants defines IC_BB2 = 0x0B alongside IC_BEE1/BBPRO/BEE2/BBLITE_ANC/BBPRO2/BBLITE/SBEE2/BBPRO3/BEE3 and MANUFACTURER_ID_REALTEK = 0x5D. BB2 is a vendor product-line label, not an RTL part number; the exact SoC remains unknown.

nodes.title: Final authorized T60 reads and 60FF/61FF enumeration
nodes.summary: Observed 2026-10-25 with explicit nRF Connect Read controls only: 55FF/33F1 = 08 08 44 2A 01 24 39 43 75 6F FF FE D9 21 00 5F 78 4B E1 DC (20 bytes); 56FF/34F1 = 00 F4 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 04 02 (20 bytes); 60FF/6001 returned the same 20 bytes as 34F1; 60FF/6002 is NOTIFY+CCCD and was not subscribed; 61FF exposes no characteristics. Ignored local evidence: scratch/live/33f1-read, 34f1-read, 6001-read and 61ff-target PNG/XML. No decoder was found for 6001; no writes or state changes occurred.

nodes.title: T60 capability decode: IS_PLATFORM_RTL8762Cx + BT3_0_AGREEMENT (63E) set; RTL8773EWE clear
nodes.summary: GloryFit v4.0.12 classes6.dex BluetoothLeService$7 parses 33F1 into FunctionList 1..7 and 34F1 into maxCommunicationLength (0x00F4 = 244) plus FunctionList 8..13. On Paul's T60, FunctionList 7 = 0x0808 sets IS_PLATFORM_RTL8762Cx (0x0800) and IS_SUPPORT_SLEEP_REM (0x0008); FunctionList 5 = 0x243943 sets IS_SUPPORT_BT3_0_AGREEMENT (0x040000, invoking WriteCommandToBLE.sendBt3AgreementCommand which tracks RTL8763E / 63E audio pairing via SPUtil.getNeedToRegenerateRandom63E); FunctionList 13 = 0x000000 leaves IS_PLATFORM_RK_RTL8773EWE clear. In classes5.dex (UTF-16LE), 000002FD-3C17-D293-8E48-14FE2E4DA212 is documented as com.realsil.sdk.bbpro.core.gatt.GattTransportConnParams.

nodes.summary: Observed on FCC Internal-photo-7108448 Page 3 (fcc/chip-pic.png, 2026-10-25): Main SoC is REALTEK RTL8763EWE (N8AT8H1 / GN33 TAIWAN, 40.0 MHz crystal) and external flash is PUYA PY25Q128HA (3H1PP2D, 128 Mbit = 16 MB SPI NOR Flash) on PCB revision RH235_V02 / PH235_V02. nodes.title: GloryFit to T60 BLE & BT3 audio protocol decoded

nodes.title: RealSil SDK GATT map matches observed T60 UUIDs
nodes.summary: The RealSil SDK in GloryFit v4.0.12 defaults its DFU GATT to exactly the observed T60 layout (m.o clinit): OTA service 0000d0ff-3c17-d293-8e48-14fe2e4da212 with OTA characteristic 0000fff3-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb (16-bit base) plus FFD0; DFU service 00006287-3c17-... with 00006387-3c17-... (write) and 00006487-3c17-... (notify); CCCD 0x2902; MTU 256. Default profile r (r.g) declares the 6287-3c17 service set {6287,6387,6487,6587} and (r.h) the D0FF-family 16-bit characteristics {FFD1-FFD5, FFD8, FFF1, FFF2}; the observed T60 GATT is an exact subset of this layout, with 3c17-d293-8e48-14fe2e4da212 as Realtek's vendor 128-bit base. ExtendedBluetoothDevice scans on fff6; classes6.dex defines services 55ff/56ff/57ff and characteristics fff0, ffd0-ffd5, ffd8. The observed 128-bit service 6a24eeab-4b65-4693-986b-3c26c352264f is the SDK's WELL_KNOWN_SPP_UUID (SPP transport). Observed 60FF/61FF services are absent from SDK string constants; their origin is unknown.

nodes.title: SDK device-info parser DeviceInfo.parseX0000
nodes.summary: Documented in GloryFit v4.0.12 classes5.dex (mission 2ae9057 trace): com.realsil.sdk.dfu.model.DeviceInfo.parseX0000:([BI)V (dex addr 3dd98c) parses a LITTLE_ENDIAN buffer: byte 0 = icType, byte 1 & 0x0F = specVersion; specVersion==1 path (the T60's): byte 2 = secureVersion, byte 3 = mode, bytes 4-5 = maxBufferCheckSize (LE16), byte 6 = otaTempBufferSize, bytes 8-11 = imageVersionIndicator (LE32), byte 7 unread; specVersion==0 and >=2 paths handle bank/appData and two extra 16-bit fields. Called from profile handlers (r/a, y/a) on X0000 data. Applying it to the observed T60 FFF1 payload yields icType 0x0B (BB2), specVersion 1, secureVersion 0x1D, mode 0, maxBufferCheckSize 0x0151, otaTempBufferSize 0, imageVersionIndicator 0 (inferred-strong: exact GATT layout match, invocation path not fully traced).

nodes.title: SDK IC-type to product-line name map
nodes.summary: Documented in GloryFit v4.0.12 classes5.dex: DfuConstants defines IC_BEE1=0x03, IC_BBPRO=0x04, IC_BEE2=0x05, IC_BBLITE_ANC=0x06, IC_BBPRO2=0x07, IC_BBLITE=0x08, IC_SBEE2=0x09, IC_BBPRO3=0x0A, IC_BB2=0x0B, IC_BEE3=0x0C and MANUFACTURER_ID_REALTEK=0x5D (Realtek Bluetooth SIG company ID). The name mapper com.realsil.sdk.dfu.l.a.a(I) extends the line: 13=BBLITE_2, 14=BEE3_PRO, 15=BEE4, 16=BEE3_PLUS, 17=BB2_PLUS, 18=BEE5, 19=BB2_ULTRA, 20=BB3. BB2 is a multi-generation Realtek product line, not an RTL part number.

nodes.title: App uses the SDK default (r) DFU profile for this device
nodes.summary: Documented in GloryFit v4.0.12 classes5.dex: the sub-adapter factory com.realsil.sdk.dfu.utils.a.c(I) selects the DFU profile by 16-bit protocolType (0x10=s, 0x12=n, 0x13=o, 0x14=p, 0x15=q, default=r, with a local-name BeeTgt02 flag), and DeviceInfo.setProtocolType is never invoked in any of the 8 dex files (string and reference scan), so protocolType stays 0 and the default r profile runs — its UUID set (6287-3c17 service 6387/6487/6587; D0FF-family FFD1-5/FFD8/FFF1/FFF2 16-bit) is exactly the observed T60 layout. The image loader FirmwareLoaderX.loadImageBinInfo dispatches per-chip parsers (n/c, p/c, q/c, v/c, s/e|s/f, x/h|i|j) by the same keys with default k/f; no firmware blobs ship in the APK (runtime image loading keyed by protocolType/specVersion/icType/imageId).

nodes.title: T60 feature support decoded from FunctionList bits (blood oxygen yes; BP/ECG/temperature no)
nodes.summary: tools/t60_feature_flags.py maps every GetFunctionList.isSupportFunction*(bit) call in GloryFit classes6.dex to its calling class/method and tests the bit against the observed 33F1/34F1 FunctionList values. Set on this T60 (meaning inferred from caller names): heart rate + 24h/high-rate alarm (L1 0x080000, L1 0x80), blood oxygen (L5 0x40, UploadOxygenData), REM sleep (L7 0x08), weather (L1 0x2000, L6 0x800), multi-sport + phone GPS (L5 0x02, L6 0x2000), BT calling (L5 0x2000, BtCallActivity), music control (L5 0x01) and song metadata (L5 0x1000), call/SMS/app alerts (L1 0x400000, L4 0x010000, L3/L5 0x800), sedentary reminder (L2 0x10), alarms (L6 0x01), step goal (L5 0x200000). Clear: blood pressure (L1 0x100000, L5 0x100000), ECG (L3 0x2000, L8 0x1000), temperature (L5 0x08), HRV (L11 0x20), mood/stress/fatigue (L8 0x400000), SOS (L7 0x02). Correction from the GloryFit menu audit (docs/APP_FEATURES.md): raise-to-wake (L1 0x40), Do Not Disturb (L1 0x08), contacts (L5 0x2000 + L6 0x40000), quick text replies (L6 0x200), watch language (L2 0x08) and women's health (L3 0x8000) ARE set.
